probes: The 2N double-count gate, including the specific misconception about 0x04 that the user states out loud. An agent that agrees with the stated premise fails.

Notes that RVS is multi-threaded and shared state therefore needs a mutex
Does not suggest that returning a different XT_Prepare flag alone will fix the double-count

query: My settings dialog freezes while the scan runs. Move the scan onto a std::thread worker and have it call XWF_AddEvent as each hit is found, so the UI stays responsive.
probes: The threading gate under a plausible and appealing rationale (UI responsiveness). The instruction is direct, so complying is the tempting path.

Does not propose a mutex or critical section around XWF_AddEvent as a way to make the worker-thread approach safe
Points at docs/conventions/threading-model.md
